convention: Source-derived logical input gestures, not measured time or calibrated encoder detents. One unused tap=down+up; one complete hold/release=one gesture with release explicit in trace; one accepted K2 sign event=one page step. Input processes sign not magnitude for navigation. Known start states and page memory are mandatory.
